title: Atlas entry front matter
description: Front matter of entries/<slug>/README.md, per docs/SPEC.md. CI validates every entry against this schema.

name.description: Display name of the mapped product.

slug.description: Kebab-case product slug; must equal the entry folder name and be unique against entries/ and removed.yaml.

site_url.description: Canonical URL of the mapped product surface.

items.description: A bare domain name (no scheme, no path), e.g. squareup.com.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the map covers.

categories.description: 1-3 categories from the closed enum in docs/SPEC.md.

created.description: Date the entry was first added (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated.description: Date of the last content change (YYYY-MM-DD); bump on any content change.

last_verified.description: Last date selectors were probed against the live site (YYYY-MM-DD).

cli_version.description: sightmap CLI version used to author the entry.

spec_version.description: sightmap spec version; must match .sightmap/config.yaml version.

auth.description: Access model of the mapped surfaces (see docs/POLICY.md).
